blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Bohol Gov. Erico Aristotle “Aris” Aumentado has called on tourism operators and stakeholders to ensure that the province’s growing tourism industry benefits not only large establishments but also ordinary Boholanos.
